## Summary

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue or relevant design when available.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their outcomes. For UI changes, include screenshots or interaction evidence. Distinguish simulator checks from physical-device validation.

## Advisory review

- Check the bot comment's exact base/head and status after the latest push.
- Assess supported findings, fix and test them, and push to this same PR for a fresh review.
- Record unresolved findings and any incomplete, failed, unavailable or excluded review scope. AI advice does not replace deterministic checks or human judgment.

## Risks and release effects

Describe migrations, configuration, credentials, privacy implications, rollback and unverified release gates. A merge does not deploy the marketplace.
